g.text: HBO Renews Sharon Horgan Comedy ‘Youth’ For a Season 2 ◆ Roku Delivers Another Stellar Quarter: Q3 Sales Soar 24% as Media and Entertainment Ad Spending Sees Biggest Growth in Four Years ◆ ‘Sex Education’ Star Asa Butterfield Signs With Linden Entertainment (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Screen Savers: Magic Walls, Big Boards Become Critical to TV-News Election Night Success ◆ Driven Unveils Original Programming Slate, Including Series Starring Tom Nelson, Emelia Hartford and Tanner Foust (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ ‘Ellen DeGeneres Show’ EP Matthew Wright Dies at 52 in ‘Unfathomable Tragedy’; DeGeneres Shares Tearful Video Calling Him the ‘Glue to Our Family’ ◆
